IV. Flow Controls

Increase or decrease the flow rates. This is automatically controlled by the samophlange control mechanism.

V. Temperature Gauge

Displays the operating temperature of the system in general.

Brief listing of control console components (from left to right)

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

227853|066d9580.name: Pix Xizzix
227853|066d9580.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

248201|5de3438e.name: Pawani
248201|5de3438e.text: Greetings, friend! I have an ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256388|631ab615.name: Jornah
256388|631ab615.text:
Recently there has been a sharp rise in lost orders. We strive to ensure that each delivery is efficient and safe, but with a rise of bandits, rowdy creatures, and those damned Alliance, inevitably not every delivery goes according to plan.

Should you find these shipments, take a look over the label for what it should contain. It is not your responsibility to deal with our mistakes, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind. 

Dokimi over by the wagon can handle the logistics and your compensation. We will take it from there.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

2832|78a6229e.name: Nixxrax Fillamug
2832|78a6229e.text: First drink's on me! The coin to pay for it, that is. On my hand. From you.

2834|c2467ddc.name: Myizz Luckycatch
2834|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

2858|d37b59d0.name: Gringer
2858|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3352|08830bac.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3352|fd7e1800.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|fd7e1800.text: I have much knowledge to impress upon you, $c. You must learn to hunt with honor.

3365|0443423e.name: Karolek
3365|0443423e.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3703|c3a4816f.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|c3a4816f.text: Have you come for further training? Shake the dust of the road from your garments, then, and let us get to work.

5811|e65e27ca.name: Kamari
5811|e65e27ca.text: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6807|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces
